messages.subject: Newer INLA version model output
parts:
Hi all!

In the past, I was using 21.1.26 version of INLA, and recently I updated the package to 21.11.22 and then to 22.1.25.

I noticed two distinctions related to model output between the older (21.1.26) version, on the one hand, and newer (21.11.22 and 22.1.25) versions, on the other hand:
1) neffp is no longer calculated
2) when rerunning the same model I no longer get identical results (e.g. marginals of random and fixed effects and waic values differ) even when I set the same seed (set.seed(123)).

I was wondering:
1) whether it was indeed the change that happened between the versions and not an error dependent on another package, for instance (and whether there are other options of calculating neffp on my own)
2) if there are ways to keep the model outputs (if model and data remain the same) consistent without downgrading to previous INLA versions.

I hope this makes sense and thank you in advance for your help.

Best,
Alyona
